messages:
maya_cs: Heads-up team 11 DeltaHealth renewal: customer wants 9mo term, +12 seats prorated, and EU entity on invoice. They requested wire payment but need EU signer on SOW. Sending draft: https://drive.redwood/DeltaHealth/so_revA.pdf :paperclip:

sam_ae: Reaching out to procurement contact now to confirm whether they'll send an amended PO or a new PO header. I'll ask them to include billing entity + KYC and cc finance@deltahealth.com. ETA ~90m.

alex_fin: Treasury note: to make the 4/12 wire we need PO and matching invoice lines by EOD 2026-04-10. If PO misses that, next wire cycle is 4/15. Also we need standard invoice stub for metadata: Invoice: RWI-2026-0427-DELTA / Amount: EUR 78,450.00 / PO: [placeholder]. Share bank details via secure channel.

julie_legal: Legal check: EU signer must be tied to billing entity on the SOW. If the signer isn't on our existing signer registry we need a delegate authorization form + entity KYC before DocuSign. I can prepare the delegate template; will add it to the envelope if needed.

ethan_se: I can own DocuSign routing. Once PO + billing name are confirmed I9ll create the envelope with signing order. Maya, please confirm signers and order. I'll canary-send to internal alias first.

maya_cs: Customer asked for signer order: 1) EU CFO (primary), 2) Local Ops (witness), 3) Redwood exec. Also they mentioned VAT remit could require split invoice. Sam, please confirm whether they want split invoices or single invoice in your outreach.

sam_ae: Noted. I'll confirm PO header, KYC, and whether they require invoice split. Will ask them to provide a single email with PO + KYC to avoid back-and-forth.

alex_fin: If they request split invoice, we need final line-item breakdown by 4/11 09:00 PT to print separate invoices. Otherwise go single invoice.

julie_legal: Small flag: split invoices trigger additional legal review for taxation; if they push on split, allow extra 24h.

maya_cs: Proposed playbook: (1) Sam confirms PO + KYC + split-invoice intent by 14:30 UTC, (2) Legal issues delegate form if signer not on file by EOD, (3) Ethan routes DocuSign as soon as billing entity verified, (4) Finance aims for 4/12 wire if docs in time. If not, wire moves to 4/15. Sound good?

ethan_se: Sounds good. I'll wait for Sam9s confirmation then create envelope and post envelope id here. Docsign-bot will remind to attach delegate form if used.

docsign-bot: Reminder: DocuSign envelope created by ethan_se will follow signing order. Attach "delegate_authorization.pdf" if using a delegate signer.

sam_ae: Update: procurement replied; they will send an amended PO and attached entity KYC in one email. Expect PO in ~70 minutes. They prefer a single invoice if possible but asked about VAT split options.

maya_cs: Great work. If PO + KYC arrive within the ETA, alex_fin can schedule for 4/12. If anything slips post the update here and we9ll shift to next cycle. :thumbsup:
